_doc: M1.1 PROPOSAL (combat designer, docs/design/_drafts/m1.1/combat-skills.md). Ability ranks 1-3. Rank 1 = the ability as in content/default/abilities.json. Each rank lists JSON-pointer changes relative to the ability object; rank 3 applies on top of rank 2. Units follow the abilities.json suffixes. Basic attacks do not rank (rankable false).
status: PROPOSED · TUNABLE (2026-10-26); combat balance pass 2026-10-26 (m1.1/tune-combat): control cooldown steps, rank-3 trims

damage: rank 3: cooldown x0.9 (nearest 0.5 s, at least 0.5 s shorter)
area_damage: rank 3: area +0.5 m radius (+1 m line, +1 chain jump, +0.5 m zone radius)
control: rank 2: cooldown about x0.8 (nearest 0.5 s; set per ability from the harness)

rank 3: cooldown a further ~15% shorter (about x0.65 of rank 1), focus cost -5 (min 10), damage coefficients x1.10, and area +0.5 m (+1 m line) where the ability has one; control durations never change
heal: rank 3: cooldown x0.9 (Rejuvenate -0.25 s, Rewind Wounds -0.5 s; Suture trimmed to focus cost -5, no cooldown cut)
buff: rank 2: buff durations +1 s (zone abilities: zone duration)
debuff: rank 2: debuff and slow magnitudes x1.2 (capped)
rank 3: debuff durations +1 s (zone abilities: zone duration)
passive: rank 3: every magnitude x1.5 of rank 1 (radii, thresholds, intervals, flags and windup never scale)

eligibility.note: no level gate: skills are already rare (levels.json offers.skillEveryNthLevel)
